newsitem.title: UK: Easier UK meals/feeds find buyers at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: Easier UK meals/feeds find buyers at lower levels.

text.p: Reduction of around one to three stg a tonne in high protein soymeal prices on the UK meals market on Wednesday triggered a limited amount of buying interest.
Ex-mill high pro was around one to three stg down with stores down by similar amounts.
On the east coast high pro fetched 187 stg a tonne for Feb/Apr and 166 stg for May/Oct.
Home produced wheat feed pellets traded at 86.50 stg a tonne ex-mill London while in Liverpool 78.50 stg was paid for spot citrus pulp pellets.
However, traders said volmues were small.
